name: story-skills
description: A suite of cross-referenced skills and CLI maintenance tools for end-to-end story writing powered by markdown. Covers story initialization, character management, worldbuilding, plot structure, chapter writing, revision, validation, reporting, indexing, word counts, and manuscript export. / 一套互相引用的技能与 CLI 维护工具，用 markdown 端到端支撑故事写作。覆盖故事初始化、角色管理、世界观、情节结构、章节写作、修订、校验、报告、索引、字数统计与稿件导出。

interface.displayName: Story Skills · 故事写作技能集
interface.shortDescription: Plan stories, manage characters and worlds, and write chapters. / 规划故事，管理角色与世界，撰写章节。
interface.longDescription: Story Skills adds end-to-end fiction-writing workflows for Codex: story initialization, character management, worldbuilding, plot structure, chapter writing, revision and continuity audits, and deterministic project maintenance with markdown registries and YAML frontmatter. / Story Skills 为 Codex 加入端到端的虚构写作工作流：故事初始化、角色管理、世界观、情节结构、章节写作、修订与连续性审查，以及基于 markdown 注册表与 YAML frontmatter 的确定性项目维护。
